note: The fourth campaign, proposed 10 August 2026 on John's instruction after James and Andy asked for it: most customer relationships are arms length, a web shop purchase at some point, and those customers have never been shown the Richards Industrials ranges PCT now supplies. This campaign runs on relationship rather than events: no sweep, no gate, members seeded in deliberate waves from the imported customer base by scripts/seed-reactivation.mjs, scored on the relationship itself so a seeded wave becomes leads without waiting for news, and drafted to as known customers, which the drafter's existing-customer briefing already enforces. Status manual and it stays manual until the first wave's drafts have been read line by line and the positioning wording below has James's sanction; both are the calibration event. The trust and range lines are the conservative corpus-grounded forms; James may strengthen them, which is a field edit here.

positioning.positioningRule: Position the Richards ranges as the wider catalogue behind a relationship that already exists, never as a cold introduction and never as a data sheet.
